title: Effect
description: An atomic, reusable effect in the shared effect registry. Spells, consumables (potions/poisons/coatings), ingredients, and enchantments all reference these by id via schema.json#/definitions/appliedEffect. Some effects (especially poisons) support composition via sub_effects (other effects applied as payload/symptoms when this one takes hold).

key.description: Symbolic snake_case key (the old string id, e.g. 'fortify_skill', 'restore_resource') for human readability when editing JSON.

label.description: Human-readable display name with spaces and capitalization (e.g. 'Fortify Skill').

polarity.description: Used by alchemy to sort effects into potions (beneficial) vs poisons (harmful)

color.description: Default color magic school when this effect is delivered as a spell; omit for purely mundane effects

phase.description: Optional Wuxing five-phase tag. Drives elemental interaction (amplify/suppress/drain/backlash) with other phased effects per data/wuxing; orthogonal to color. Omit for non-elemental effects.

magnitudeUnit.description: How an appliedEffect.magnitude is interpreted for this effect

defaultDuration.description: Default duration in seconds when not overridden by the appliedEffect

defaultDurationType.description: Default for fortify effects: 'unlimited' (stackable) or 'temporal' (override with highest magnitude).

stackable.description: Whether multiple instances stack or refresh

channels.description: Delivery vectors permitted to draw this effect from the pool. 'innate' is used for permanent character traits, racial features, and creation boons/drawbacks.

sub_effects.description: Other effect IDs that this effect applies (recursively) when it takes hold on a target. Used by poison effects to deliver symptoms (e.g. damage, drain, control effects). A poison effect (any effect with 'poison' in its tags or delivered via poison/coating channel) MUST NOT list any other effect that has 'poison' in its tags, to prevent infinite recursion or self-poisoning.
